tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250rnal 'byor rang gi grib srung ba dang sel ba'i gdams ngag grib sel gser gyi pha wang zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 1$0000300na mo gu ru u tsuṣma kro dhā ya/ 'chol ba'i khro rgyal de la phyag 'tshal lo//

sdom gsum ldan pa'i rnal 'byor sgrub pa pos// zas grib gos grib ro dang btsog gi grib// dam tshig nyams dang grib can 'grogs pa'i grib/ khams mi bde zhing bying rmugs shes pa 'thibs// nad kyis btab dang tshe yi bar chad sdig /de dag ma byung gong nas srung ba 'am// byung na sngags dang dmigs pas sel ba'i thabs// bka' gter gsar rnying man ngag rgya mtsho'i bcud// dmigs pa sngags gnyis kho nas chog pa yin// rang gi snying gar hūm̐ yig ljang gu las// me 'bar rang gi lus dang grib kun bsregs// stongs par gyur rjes skad cig dran rdzogs su// rang nyid khro bo sme brtsegs ljang gu ni// ljang dkar sngo ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug pa// dang po'i phyag gnyis thugs kar sdigs mdzub bsnol// bar pas gser gyi rdo rje dril bu gdengs// tha mas lcags kyu dang ni zhags pa bsnams// dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa la// sbrul sngon lto ba ser khra can gyis dkris// stag lpags la sogs dur khrod chas brgyad gsol// bgegs dang gza' gdon nyi zla pad steng bzhugs// sku las ye shes me ri smug nag 'bar// de rgyab phyi rol khro bo'i gur khang ni// rdo rje gnod sbyin nag po sku che ba// rdo rjes gtams pa'i phag rgod mche ba 'dzin// lto ba che zhing yan lag rags pa'i gur// de rgyab bdud rtsi 'khyil pa ljang gu ni// rgya gram dbyug pa sdigs mdzub mdzad pa'i gur// de rgyab phyogs mtshams steng 'og bcu po ru// dme brtsegs dbu dgu mdung thabs sku mdog nag /phyag bzhi 'byung ba bzhi yi 'khor lo 'dzin// zhabs bzhi 'byung ba bzhi brdzis me dpung 'bar// de rgyab rlung nag 'tshubs ma'i gur khang dang*// de rgyab rgya mtsho rba klong 'khrugs pa'i gur// de rgyab gser gyi pha wang ser po'i gur// pha wang re la lcags sdig re res mtshan// lcags sdig rwa rtser srid pa'i bya khyung lding*// rang gi spyi bor rigs kyi yum chen lnga// phyag na rin chen bum pa bdud rtsis bkang*// kun gyi gnas gsum yig 'bru gsum po las// 'od 'phros ye shes pa rnams spyan drangs bstim/

/rang gi thugs kar nyi steng hūm̐ ljang mthar// sngags phreng g.yas su 'khor las 'od zer 'phros/ khro bo'i gur la thim pas khro bo rnams// thugs las 'od 'phros bdag la phog pa yis// lus ngag yid gsum grib rnams dag par gyur// spyi bo'i lha mo lnga yi bum pa nas// bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs rang gi spyi bor zhugs// dam tshig chag nyams grib dang mi gtsang ba// thams cad dud khu sol khu'i rnam pa ru// rkang mthil 'og sgo ba spu'i bu gar thon// phyi rol khro bo rnams kyis lhag med gsol// oṃ bhur khung ma hā pra ma ṇa ye bhur tsi bhur ki bhi ma le u tsuṣma ma hā kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa brgya'am nyi shu rtsa gcig gi mthar/ oṃ e ho shuddhe shuddhe/ yaṃ ho shuddhe shuddhe/ raṃ ho shuddhe shuddhe/ baṃ ho shuddhe shuddhe/ laṃ ho shuddhe shuddhe/ e yaṃ raṃ baṃ laṃ shuddhe shuddhe tsitta raṃ shuddhe a a swā hā/ de nas mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang la bzhag /rgyun du byas na grib kyis mi tshugs shing*// grib kha byung dus bsgom bzlas byas pas sel// 'di ni gsar rnying rgyud sde du ma'i bcud/ khyad par gar gyi dbang phyug rol pa rtsal// rig 'dzin chen po'i zhal gyi bdud rtsi lags// de skad rta lo tha skar zla ba yi// gung thun rā ga a syas smras pa ste// 'brong rigs dge bshes padma thabs mkhas kyis// phyi rabs 'gro la phan phyir 'phral du bris// nyes 'gal mchis na ye shes lha la bshags// dge bas 'gro kun skyon dang bral gyur cig /dge'o/// /
